originalityClaim: The creator attributes the conception and design of this distinctive integrated notebook architecture to Anouar Oumlili. This records the creator's claim and project provenance; it is not an independent worldwide novelty determination.
inventionDescription: Unlike a conventional notes-only notebook, the documented concept brings five connected spaces into one notebook experience: literary writing for poems, texts and ideas; an in-app reading library; Quran radio and spoken lessons; a tasbeeh and remembrance counter; and book creation from the user's writing with import and export. Supporting tools include archive, radio access, day/night appearance, colors, backup, and one-tap QR creation for pages, websites and poems.
designDistinction: The claimed innovation is the integrated structure and workflow of these literary, reading, audio, devotional and publishing spaces in one notebook experience, not the generic idea of a digital notebook.
purpose: Attribution, provenance, and identification of the creator's distinctive notebook concept in project files and deployments.
verificationStatus: Attribution marker only; not yet a cryptographic signature. The originality statement is the creator's claim and is not a substitute for independent prior-art research or legal registration.
privacy: No visitor data collection, telemetry, remote reporting, or local-storage access. Public location is city and country only.
